args.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Seoul Hero future effect 8-frame animation source sheet.
Primary request: ONE reusable transparent 2D raster effect for Seoul Hero, three thin horizontal bands with offset breaks and one gently curling end. Design language: teal rectangular indicator panes connected by sparse white microdots. Thick readable silhouette, limited cel-painted texture, clean alpha, no background, ground shadow, frame, letters, numbers, interface, character or item illustration. Keep the origin registered at the same central anchor and include safe margin. This asset is an isolated flow layer, not a complete screen. Deliver an aligned eight-frame sequence in EXACTLY FOUR COLUMNS by TWO ROWS, eight identical square cells. Read frames 1-4 left-to-right on the top row and frames 5-8 left-to-right on the bottom row. Preserve the same camera, registration, scale and outer safe margin in all cells; transparent background between and inside cells. Exactly eight frames at 12 fps: 1 quiet precursor (10% opacity), 2 gather narrow fragments inward, 3 concentrate the core, 4 rapid outward reveal, 5 strongest fully readable silhouette, 6 separate the broad fragments, 7 sparse soft afterglow, 8 transparent end with only two faint residue marks. Shape morphing must be continuous; do not redraw unrelated effects between cells. No frame borders or frame labels.
Style: original crisp Korean mobile-game hand-painted raster art, strong readable silhouettes, clean navy outlines where appropriate, restrained cel shading and material highlights. Follow the specific subject palette in the brief. Create a new silhouette and object, with no copied reference subject.
Reusable raster VFX artwork ONLY, no UI screenshot, icon, background or object being upgraded. Preserve colored translucent luminous edges, clean real alpha, not a black or checkerboard rectangle. No letters, numbers, labels, borders or floor shadow.
Layout: EXACTLY 8 animation frames in a strict FOUR COLUMNS by TWO ROWS grid, read left-to-right then top-to-bottom. Each frame same canvas dimensions and FIXED CENTER PIVOT. No dividing lines, no captions. One evolving effect, coherent shape progression from charging through peak to fading, isolated within each cell with safe padding; no inter-cell spill. Wide 2:1 sheet. Actual transparent background in EVERY cell. No unrelated effects.
Background: actual transparent RGBA, no opaque backdrop, no fake checkerboard.
Constraints: no text, logos, watermark, UI chrome, labels or numbers. Preserve the requested anatomy and view.

Registration safety: Each complete effect, including its glow and detached fragments, fits within the central 60 percent of its square cell. Leave at least 20 percent transparent clearance at EVERY cell edge. Never cut off a beam tip, ring, spark or particle. All eight cells have exactly the same fixed center.
